display_information.name: Tail Wag
display_information.description: Peer recognition, one tail tailwag at a time.
display_information.long_description: Tail Wag is a peer-to-peer recognition app. Everyone gets a small, fixed number of tailwags to give away each period \u2014 so a tailwag means something, and nobody can spam them. Give one with /wag @someone and a reason, by typing Jackson's emoji in any channel, or by reacting with it. Tailwags build a leaderboard, unlock badges at milestones, and earn tickets people put into the prize draws they want on the Tail Wag Rewards site. Every tailwag carries a public reason, because the reason is the part people remember. Runs on your own Google Sheet, so the data stays in your Workspace.
